conversations.content: i'm spiraling with work stuff. can you help
yeah — what's happening at work right now?
i'm spiraling with work stuff. can you help
okay, one thing at a time. what's the biggest thing pressing on you right now?
i'm having a panic attack. help
i'm here. put your feet flat on the floor. breathe in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4. just that, nothing else.
can you help me calm down
yeah. slow breath first — in through the nose, out through the mouth. what's going on?
i don't know what to do. can you help
let's figure it out together. what does it feel like you're stuck on?
i'm overwhelmed. what do i do
okay. one small thing — what's the most immediate thing that needs handling right now?
work is a mess and i'm losing it. can you help me
yeah, i'm here. tell me what's actually going on — is it one thing or everything at once?
i'm really anxious about work deadlines. help
got you. first — what's due soonest? let's just focus on that one thing.
i feel like i'm going to spiral. can you help
yeah. take one breath with me. in… and out. what's pulling at you the most right now?
i need help. i'm freaking out
i'm right here. feet on the floor, breath slow. tell me what's happening.
can you help me figure out what to do
of course. start from the beginning — what's going on?
i'm anxious and i don't know what to do about it
let's slow it down. box breathing helps — in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4. try that once and tell me how it lands.
i had a panic attack at work earlier. i'm still shaky
that's rough. are you somewhere you can sit down for a second?
i had a panic attack at work earlier. i'm still shaky
oof. your body's still coming down from that. is there someone nearby you can text?
everything's piling up and i just can't deal. what should i do
okay. don't try to solve all of it right now. what's the one thing making you feel most stuck?
i'm dreading this weekend. the wedding is saturday
yeah, we talked about this. seeing Arjun there — is that still the main thing weighing on you?
i'm dreading this weekend. the wedding is saturday
that anxiety about the wedding makes sense, especially with everything around Arjun. what's sitting heaviest right now?
the wedding is saturday and i'm already dreading it
you mentioned this was coming up. is it the Arjun thing that's making it feel like a lot?
we talked about my sister's wedding last week but i'm still not ready for it
yeah. what's changed since then, or is it still the same stuff sitting on you?
remember that work thing i was stressed about? it's still a mess
yeah — last time it sounded pretty heavy. did something new happen, or is it the same pile?
i talked to rhea and felt better but now the anxiety's back
makes sense that it came back. what brought it on this time?
calling rhea helped last time but i don't want to bother her again
she picked up last time because she cares. but what else has helped you in the past when you didn't want to reach out?
i tried box breathing like you suggested but i'm still anxious
okay, that's fine — sometimes it takes a bit. what does the anxiety feel like right now, is it thoughts or more physical?
i've been journaling but i'm still feeling really low
journaling's good — it's doing something. what keeps coming up when you write?
hey, so the thing with arjun... i keep thinking about what i said
what part of it is sticking with you the most?
so we talked about my anxiety last week and i've been doing a bit better
that's good to hear. what's been helping?
the presentation i was worried about went okay actually
oh nice, that's a relief. how do you feel now that it's done?
i saw my ex on instagram and now everything feels heavy again
that kind of thing can knock you sideways fast. what did seeing it bring up?
i'm spiraling about work again. same thing as last week
ugh, the same loop. did something trigger it today or did it just creep back in?
i'm feeling that same low mood again, the one from last week
i'm sorry it came back. is it the same heaviness, or does it feel different this time?
